public_evidence: The published meta-analysis reports UK Biobank diagnosed and proxy dementia cases and controls.
cross_trait_overlap_status: Known overlap with the lipid meta-analysis through UK Biobank; exact participant intersection is unavailable from summary statistics.
interpretive_consequence: Genome-wide MR and MVMR are interpreted as causal-scope sensitivity analyses rather than overlap-free causal estimates.

public_evidence: Both primary publications explicitly identify UK Biobank participation.
cross_trait_overlap_status: Direction of overlap is confirmed, but cohort-level covariance and participant identifiers are not public.
interpretive_consequence: Potential weak-instrument bias toward confounded observational association is considered when interpreting genome-wide MR results.
